city_status.summary_sr: Vazduh u Beogradu je umerenog kvaliteta; osetljive grupe mogu osetiti blagi uticaj.
city_status.summary_en: Air quality in Belgrade is moderate; sensitive individuals may experience slight effects.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacujem Connectorovu tvrdnju o jednakom vremenu proteklom od prijema: SEPA je poslednji put primljena pre 58 min, građanski senzori pre 18 min, a SEPA ne daje vreme merenja. Ne mogu da pretvorim tišinu Tanjuga, Danasa i Studija B u dokaz mirnog grada; ove činjenice beleže odsustvo prijema, a ne odsustvo događaja. [F2][F4][F7][F8][F9]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I reject Connector's claim of matching reception ages: SEPA last arrived 58 min ago, citizen sensors 18 min ago, and SEPA supplies no measurement time [F2][F4]. I cannot turn the silence at Tanjug, Danas and Studio B into evidence of a quiet city; these facts record absent arrivals, not absent events [F7][F8][F9].
